description: This source file defines extension methods for configuring and adding Redis as a grain directory provider in Orleans. It provides methods to set up default or named Redis grain directories, configuring options and dependency injection.

classes.name: RedisGrainDirectoryExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for ISiloBuilder and IServiceCollection to configure Redis as a grain directory in Orleans.

methods.name: UseRedisGrainDirectoryAsDefault
methods.description: Configures the silo builder to use Redis as the default grain directory with the given options.

methods.name: UseRedisGrainDirectoryAsDefault
methods.description: Overload that accepts an action to configure RedisGrainDirectoryOptions.

methods.name: AddRedisGrainDirectory
methods.description: Adds a named Redis grain directory with specified options to the silo builder.

methods.name: AddRedisGrainDirectory
methods.description: Overload that accepts an action to configure OptionsBuilder for RedisGrainDirectoryOptions.
